function: Port selection for downlink CSI acquisition and feedback in FDD cell-free massive MIMO; a DNN (DL-JPS) imitates the greedy search GS-JPS (p. 7).
system: B=3 BSs with M=64 antennas each serve U=6 single-antenna users, FDD, 2.1 GHz downlink, urban microcell; no RIS (p. 8).
method: DL-JPS: CNN (3 convolutional, 3 fully connected layers) trained in a supervised way on GS-JPS labels with cross-entropy loss and Adam (pp. 7-8).
data_channel: Own simulated beamspace channel: truncated Laplacian port power profile, exponential port correlation, path loss with f0=2.1 GHz; 9000 training samples, train-to-test ratio 4 (p. 8).
test_conditions: Training and testing on the same simulated setup (train-to-test ratio 4); DL-JPS accuracy reported per setting of ports P and correlated ports L0, M=32 (pp. 8, 11).
baselines: Non-learned: SLNR-PS [16] and MM-S [32] port selection, GS-JPS as the teacher of DL-JPS, feedback without compression; no learned baseline (pp. 8, 11).
metrics: Sum-rate (bps/Hz), compression ratio of port coefficients (CCDF), feedback overhead in bits, port-selection accuracy of DL-JPS (pp. 8-11).
complexity: Big-O order for GS-JPS and SLNR-PS (p. 7); DL-JPS only 'one forward propagation' (p. 11), no operation or parameter count.
q1_support: p. 8: "the truncated Laplacian distribution [33]" - custom beamspace simulator with exponential port correlation; no 3GPP TR 38.901, QuaDRiGa, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured data is used.
q2_support: p. 8: "The ratio of the training set size to the testing one is 4." - training and test data come from the same simulated setup; no model trained in one setting is tested in another.
q3_support: p. 8: "the SLNR-PS scheme and the maximum magnitude selection" - both baselines are non-learned; no earlier learned port-selection method or standard network is compared, and DL-JPS is compared only with its own teacher GS-JPS.
q4_support: p. 11: "comes from only one forward propagation of the" - qualitative remark on DL-JPS; the Big-O orders of page 7 belong to the non-learned GS-JPS and SLNR-PS.
q5_support: p. 8: "Our training dataset comprises 9000 samples." - simulated data; no link, DOI or release statement for code or data anywhere in the paper.
notes: Learning enters only through DL-JPS, a DNN that imitates the classical greedy search GS-JPS (its label source); the EDT feedback, the sum-rate derivation and GS-JPS are analytical. Included because the DNN performs the port selection of the CSI acquisition, area 2. The path loss has the 3GPP urban microcell form but the paper never cites 3GPP. For q4 the paper does give Big-O orders for its classical GS-JPS (p. 7) but none for the learned DL-JPS, so the reviewer may want to confirm this mark.
